key_insight: HealthAgentBench is a new 54-task healthcare agent benchmark that shows even strong frontier AI agents still struggle with realistic, multi-step clinical workflows.
clinical_relevance: The benchmark helps gauge which AI agents may be ready to support complex healthcare operations such as EHR modeling, medical imaging, and end-to-end patient journey tasks.
method: Agents were evaluated on end-to-end workflow success under minimal instructions
evidence_signal: Across the benchmark, overall task success was low; the best and most cost-effective agent, Codex GPT-5.5, achieved about a 42% success rate.
watch_item: Benchmark performance does not equal safe real-world clinical deployment, and the hardest tasks involve large search spaces plus compositional reasoning.
paper_title: HealthAgentBench: A Unified Benchmark Suite of Realistic Agentic Healthcare Environments for Challenging Frontier AI Agents
